questions.question: A full b-ary tree with branching factor [latex]b=3[/latex] has the goal at depth [latex]d=8[/latex]. Plug in [latex]b=3,, d=8[/latex]: [latex]\frac{3^{9}-1}{3-1}=\frac{19683-1}{2}= \frac{19682}{2}=9841.[/latex]
